title: Fairy rings, 43 prayer, kingdom, 99 thieving
seoTitle: Ironman Fairy Rings, 43 Prayer & Miscellania (OSRS Step 1.3)
description: Unlock fairy rings for fast travel, get 43 prayer for protection prayers, and set up Miscellania for passive resources.

steps.text: Buy a bronze sword from Varrock sword shop (for Horror from the deep quest)
Smith 3 bronze wire
Buy an oak longbow and a regular shortbow from Lowe
Start Priest in peril
Buy 400 steel nails at the sawmill, if every world is bought out then don't bother
Start Rag and bone man on the way to the temple
Do priest in peril
Do Nature spirit
steps.note: After quest, restore prayer at the grotto for a diary task

steps.text: Buy 1 raw shark from Canifis food shop
Do Creature of Fenkenstrain
steps.note: Use port Phasmatys furnace, you should have slime in bank, use it to get 5 ecto-tokens

steps.text: Use Chronicle tele
Go champion's guild and continue Dragon slayer, ask every question
steps.note: Buy a coif, green dhide chaps and vambs

steps.text: Kill the nearby ram, bear and unicorn for their bones (Rag and bone man quest)
Camelot tele
Kill a giant bat (Rag and bone man) south west of Catherby
Do Elemental workshop 2
steps.note: Kill one of each elementals for a diary task

steps.text: Lumby
Get anti-dragon shield from the duke
Kill a goblin for the bone for rag and bone man
Get big frog leg (you need to go in to the caves), giant rat bone (both for rag and bone man)
Start Lost city
Go to Draynor manor
Do Ernest the chicken, finish vampire slayer
Dig up the skull for fairytale part 1 while you're in the area to save some time later
Bank at Draynor
Talk to the high priest for Holy grail
Get at least 5 Dramen branches, make 2 staffs
Finish Lost city
Start Fairytale part 1
steps.note: The quest guide on os.rs.wiki lists where to get the 3 random items. If you get nature tally req, go to abyss with inv of food and kill leeches. Make sure you trap them so only 1 attacks

steps.text: Flinch Tanglefoot in this spot
Talk to martin to start Fairytale2
Buy 35 jugs of vinegar
Buy 1 marigold seed, 3 cabbage seeds, 3 onion seeds from Draynor seed market
Rescue prince ali from the jail
While you wait for Martin's crops for FT2, tele to Lumby
Start Evil Dave subquest for RFD
steps.note: If you don't have a cat then raise one now

steps.text: Kill 2 cows and make 1 soft, 1 hard leather
Smelt 1 inv of gold, should have from wintertodt
steps.note: If you didn't get any gold then go mine some from the alkharid mine. Make 1 recoil ring, 10 games necks and the rest into dueling rings. From this point just use clan wars tele as your energy recharge before teleporting to a new location

steps.text: Speak to Martin for Fairytale 2
Go unlock fairy rings at Zanaris
steps.note: Travel to these fairy rings to complete diary tasks: BIS, AIR, ALS, CIR, DIS

steps.text: Tele to POH and do Melzar's maze (Dragon slayer quest)
Walk to port Sarim jail and telegrab 2nd map piece for Dragon Slayer
Buy and repair the ship (dragon slayer)
Tele to Fally
Make unfired bowl at barb village
steps.note: Equip your anti-dragon shield and recoil ring now so you don't forget it later

steps.text: Talk to the oracle
Get the 3rd map piece for dragon slayer
Tele to Lumby
Get Ned as your captain for dragon slayer
steps.note: Make sure you have the anti-dragon shield and recoil ring equipped

steps.text: Go to Crandor and open the shortcut to Karamja volcano
steps.note: Bring swordfish/karambwans as your food. As soon as you go climb down from Crandor, climb back up for karamja medium diary task

steps.text: Kill Elvarg, you can do as many trips as you want
steps.note: There are flinch spots in the room, but honestly you shouldn't have any trouble with this fight. Step under Elvarg when eating

steps.text: Finish dragon slayer and buy a green d'hide top from Oziach
Wear gloves and pick up 5 nettles at the yews
Make the stew for Evil Dave while you're at Edgeville
steps.note: If you don't have a cat then just leave for later, don't bother doing this with a kitten

steps.text: Tele to Lumby
Fill a bowl with water, put nettles in it and use it on a range (This is for ghosts ahoy quest)
Finish Evil Dave subquest
Do Death to the Dorgeshuun. While getting the robes, keep buttons (If you didn't get them while getting the rusty sword)
Buy dorgeshuun crossbow and 4000 bone bolts
Buy a Bullseye lantern (empty) from Miltog at the market in Dorgeshkaan
Use swamp tar on the lamp still next to Miltog, use your empty lantern on the still to fill it
Finish Holy grail
steps.note: Diary steps near Galahad's house: Get a cup of tea from him, cross the log, mine coal at the coal trucks. Diary steps at Karamja: Rope swing to the moss giant island, mine gold at the horse shoe mine

steps.text: Do Horror from the deep quest
steps.note: Complete a lap of Barb agility course for a diary. Just mage the dagannoth and hide when it's weak to melee and range. Turn your run off so you don't get meleed. Use proper food like swordfish and karambwans

steps.text: Do Turael slayer with dorg cbow until 37 Range and 18 slayer
steps.note: Use Turael, every 10th task should be done with the highest level slayer master you can use. Even though we are using Turael, the goal is to get slayer xp so you should always kill monsters with higher hp, for example on bird tasks kill terrorbirds. Vannaka has too many bad tasks so I think this is overall better

steps.text: Complete Twilight's Promise quest (requires Children of the Sun; ~40 combat recommended)
steps.note: Unlocks the Quetzal Transport system for fast travel across Varlamore. Also required for later Varlamore quests including Perilous Moons.

steps.text: Try Calcified Rocks for Mining XP plus bankable Prayer shards (41 Mining, Varlamore access)
steps.note: Calcified Rocks (Cam Torum mine) require 41 Mining and yield blessed bone shards. Offering shards at the libation bowl in the Teomat gives ~5-6 Prayer XP each and requires 30 Prayer. Shards are stackable and bankable - accumulate them while Mining. Sun-kissed bones (from Hunter Rumours and other Varlamore activities) break into 45 shards each (225 Prayer XP). This shard ecosystem provides safe, bankable Prayer training that integrates with Mining and Hunter progression, reducing reliance on Wilderness altars.

steps.text: Kill tree spirits with fire strike for a mithril axe AND either another mith axe, addy axe or a rune axe, whichever is first
steps.note: The 2nd axe is for actual WC training, not worth the time camping for rune one unless u get lucky since u can just buy one at 60wc

steps.text: Do Animal magnetism
Buy mithril platebody from Horvik in Varrock
Buy mithril platelegs from al-kharid
Do Spirits of the Elid quest
steps.note: You can use the mithril armor for tanking the golems, or flinch them if you're taking too much damage

steps.text: Do the Underground pass quest
steps.note: Use the mithril armour for this quest. HCIM; While this quest might seem like a dangerous one without overheads, it's honestly not. You can trap the paladins behind each other same way as the captain from the tourist trap quest. For the spider, there are 2 skeletons on the east wall, stand between them and then mage the big one with earth blast. Sometimes the little ones attack you but just run a bit north and then back to the same spot, they'll get stuck

links.text: Video of completing the quest with same combat stats

steps.text: Upgrade the iban staff
Get 50 attack doing more Turael slayer, remember to get every 10th task from Vannaka
steps.note: If you get a task from Vannaka that you really can't do without melee protect then go kill sand crabs until 50 attack

steps.text: Make an amulet of magic
Kill blue dragons with iban's blast for 43 prayer
steps.note: We don't have the agility level for shortcut yet so don't bother banking the hides, not worth doing twice as many trips. Add 2400 xp to your current prayer xp and calculate how many bones you need, level 43 requires 50339xp and 1 bone is 288xp with ectofuntus (2.4k pray xp is from ghosts ahoy quest which will be completed before using the bones). Regular ironmen can use the wildy altar if you want to, but either way it's only around 85 bones with ecto so do whichever method. Get at least 1 extra dragon bone on top of 43 prayer, required for the Watchtower quest

steps.text: Minigame tele to fishing trawler
Buy however many buckets of slime you need for the bones
Equip Ghostspeak amulet
If you didn't prepare the nettle water earlier, do it now
Make sure you have all ghosts ahoy items
items: General store sells pots if you don't have

steps.text: Charter to port Phasmatys
Start ghosts ahoy
Grind 9 d bones and offer them, get ecto tokens
Finish ghosts ahoy
Grind the rest of your bones to get 43 prayer
Do Monkey madness, focus the reward on attack and defense
Do Wanted! quest
Get 40 slayer, Turael slay
steps.note: Reminder once again, every 10th task from Vannaka (or from chaeldar if you're already 70cb, Konar if 75cb). Prayer flicking is recommended, but Turael tasks are pretty easy so it's not mandatory. Train range to 40 first and then start training Attack

steps.text: Do Shades of morton quest
steps.note: IF there's no one else to help you then this quest can be left until later assuming you used the museum lamps on herblore earlier. Take the book to the apothecary in Varrock for some free herb xp

steps.text: Get 25 herblore if you don't have yet
Do Heroes' quest
Do Fremennik trials
Do Throne of miscellania
Do Royal Trouble
Put at least 750k gp to kingdom, set it on 10 maples and 5 herbs
steps.note: We'll be using kingdom for only 7 days at the start, make sure you go get 100% back every day for maximum yield
steps.updateNote: Set Kingdom to 10 Hardwood (Teak or Mahogany) + 5 Herbs instead of Maples. Hardwood feeds Construction training and Sailing construction. Maples are much less useful now with many better Fletching methods available.

steps.text: Go back to blackjacking for a few hours and put more money to kingdom so that it doesn't drop below 750k
steps.note: Remember to wear rogue outfit. In total you need 525k on top of the 750k to get all you need from kingdom for now

steps.text: Clean finds at the museum until you've found all 5 of the items you can get for kudos AND the ruby necklace
Do Bone Voyage quest
Set up your first bird houses

links.text: Video by Alkan showing you how to start

steps.text: Do birdhouse runs every 50mins
steps.note: Don't bother waking up every 50mins to do a run, but while playing you should at least try to be consistent with them

steps.text: AFTER your first hunter levels from a birdhouse run, RC should be your lowest skill
Do Tears of guthix quest, do the minigame weekly it's very worth it
steps.note: RC should always be your lowest skill when you do this, at least for a very long time

steps.text: Start The Giant Dwarf quest to unlock Keldagrim
Buy 2 inventories of gold ore from the blast furnace shop
Go Edgeville furnace and make plenty of digsite pendants
Make molten glass and cut gems until 45 crafting. You'll need 45 for maple birdhouse when you get the 44 hunter
steps.note: Make all of the molten glass first and if needed, craft fishbowls until 45

steps.text: Buy more seeds from Olivia at Draynor for birdhouses if needed
steps.note: Later on the farming guild shop is usually better so don't bother spending hours at Olivia, just get like 1-2k for now

steps.text: Move your house to Pollnivneach so you can do a birdhouse run every 50 mins and quickly get back to blackjacking
steps.note: Entering your POH portal from Pollnivneach portal is a diary task

steps.text: Get 88 thieving with blackjacking, should get you about 1.4m GP
steps.note: Again, LMS can be done instead if you really hate blackjacking. If u want something to AFK during this grind, i'd heavily recommend ammonite crabs to get 60 attack and then focus on either strength with D Scim or range with bone cbow. If you really like blackjacking then feel free to get higher than 88, the extra money should be used for keeping kingdom running for longer, switch to 10herbs and 5maples in that case
steps.updateNote: Rushing 88+ Thieving early isn't macroefficient according to the OSRS Wiki ironman money-making guide. Consider milestone Thieving instead: get the GP you need for kingdom and key unlocks (75 for hard diaries), then move on. The time saved can go toward quests and combat progression which compound more. Stealing Valuables in Varlamore provides steady cash later without the high click intensity. For the AFK melee suggestion in the note: Scurrius (Jan 2024, Varrock Sewers) now beats crabs for active mid-level melee training - crabs remain the truly AFK option.

steps.text: REMINDER to take out GP from kingdom after the 7th day. This thieving grind could take some people 1 day and for others multiple days so it's up to you to keep track of it. You should have 6.2k maples from kingdom when you stop using it
